mentions.name: Twenty-year long-form writing website
mentions.description: A website publishing the author's writings accumulated over twenty years. AI systems have ingested the entire archive and summarize or rewrite the work, diverting readers, while the expectation that new writing will likewise be consumed discourages further writing. The site barely sustains the author.
mentions.problem: AI systems scrape the site's twenty years of writings and steal traffic by summarizing or rewriting the work, while smothering motivation to write more; the author is barely getting by.
mentions.source_excerpt: The AIs have slurped up all of the content on my site--twenty years' worth of writings--and they are using it to ruin me.
mentions.author: DamnInteresting
